user_story: As a user, I want to receive an error message when I enter an invalid email format during registration so that I know to correct it.

positive.title: Valid email format registration
steps: Enter a valid email address (e.g., user@example.com)
Fill in the required registration fields
positive.expected_result: User is successfully registered and redirected to the welcome page.

negative.title: Invalid email format registration
steps: Enter an invalid email address (e.g., user@.com)
Fill in the required registration fields
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email format is invalid.

negative.title: Email with spaces registration
steps: Enter an email address with spaces (e.g., user @example.com)
Fill in the required registration fields
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email format is invalid.

edge.title: Email with special characters registration
steps: Enter an email address with special characters (e.g., user!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~@example.com)
Fill in the required registration fields
edge.expected_result: User is successfully registered and redirected to the welcome page if special characters are valid; otherwise, an error message is displayed.

edge.title: Empty email field registration
steps: Fill in the required registration fields
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email field cannot be empty.
